info.name: Noyo Carrier Carrier Mapped Field Lookup API
Retrieves a list of Lookup Instances

params.name: page_size
params.description: The max size of each page of results

params.name: offset
params.description: The integer offset at which to start the page. Possible values are 0 to total_records - 1

params.name: organization_id
params.description: Noyo specific organization UUID to filter

params.name: carrier_id
params.description: Noyo specific Carrier UUID to filter

params.name: group_id
params.description: Noyo specific Group UUID to filter

params.name: lookup_id
params.description: Noyo specific Lookup UUID to filter

items.docs: Returns a list of Lookup Instances.

params.name: lookup_instance_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the Lookup Instance you would like to view

items.docs: Returns the latest version of a single Lookup Instance based on the ID provided.

params.name: lookup_instance_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lookup Instance you want to edit.

params.name: version
params.description: Unique version of the Lookup Instance you want to edit.

items.docs: Update a Lookup Instance based on the ID provided. The version parameter must match the latest Lookup Instance version.

params.description: Unique identifier of the Lookup Instance you want to delete.
